title: Watership Down
blurb: A brusque, foreign-accented black-headed gull who helps the rabbits of the Sandleford warren in Richard Adams' Watership Down.
facts: Although they live in their natural wild environment, with burrows, they are anthropomorphised, possessing their own culture, language, proverbs, poetry, and mythology.
Evoking epic themes, the novel follows the rabbits as they escape the destruction of their warren and seek a place to establish a new home, encountering perils and temptations...
